race.description: Frankston Sand Soil & Mini Mix Hcp (Bm62)
race.comment: HYDROTHERMAL (7) just gets the nod in a competitive race. He was a smart maiden winner fresh then tackled a handy Class 1 at Bendigo and ran well behind Bella Verona which is good form. Has a fitness edge and should prove hard to run down. CUSHIONED (5) found the 1325m too sharp first up at Geelong but boxed on well for fourth. Up to a mile suits her much better given her form over a staying trip as a 3yo filly. ROCKZINO (8) broke through for a good maiden win at Geelong last time out. Back slightly in trip but can be handy and will be strong to the line. ISLAND BOY (2) is going okay and has minor claims while SAVANNAH CHILL (3) won in easier last time and is in the mix.
